entities.name: TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT
entities.description: Message sent by the network to the UE to provide EPS mobility management related data in response to a tracking area update request message.

entities.name: TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST
entities.description: Message that triggers the network to send the TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message.

entities.name: Tracking Area Update procedure
entities.description: Procedure where the UE sends a tracking area update request and the network responds with tracking area update accept.

relations.description: The tracking area update procedure includes sending the TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message.
The TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message is sent in response to a TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message.
The TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message is defined as part of the tracking area update procedure.
